name: FC Porto vs. CD Santa Clara
description: Experience the electric atmosphere of Portuguese football as FC Porto takes on CD Santa Clara at home. A thrilling Sunday plan for any sports enthusiast visiting or living in the city.
longDescription:
This event features a football match between FC Porto and CD Santa Clara, part of the Portuguese football league season. FC Porto, one of Portugal's most successful clubs, will host CD Santa Clara at their home stadium, Estádio do Dragão. The match is a standard league fixture, contributing to the teams' standings in the national championship.

Attendees will witness a professional football game in a large stadium setting. The atmosphere typically involves passionate support from home fans, with chants and displays of team colours. The match duration is approximately 90 minutes, plus injury time and a half-time interval. The event primarily attracts local football fans, but also visitors interested in Portuguese sports culture. The Estádio do Dragão is a modern, large-capacity stadium designed for sporting events.

Tickets are required for entry. The Estádio do Dragão is located in Porto and is directly accessible via the Estádio do Dragão metro station (lines A, B, E, F). The venue is generally considered family-friendly, though the atmosphere can be intense. Accessibility information for specific seating areas should be confirmed with the venue directly.
